name: Josa i Tuixén (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over yellow, the light blue charged with a white crescent (muntant) beneath a white fleur-de-lis and the yellow with three red roundels.
history: The official flag of Josa i Tuixén is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, a horizontal bicolour of light blue and yellow, with the white crescent and fleur-de-lis of the arms in the same arrangement, the fleur-de-lis in the concavity of the crescent; approved by the Generalitat on 11 February 2014 and published in the DOGC on 25 February 2014.

features.role: crescent with its horns upward, with a fleur-de-lis in its concavity
